_comment: OpenTelemetry (OTel) configuration — issue #5081 (S1, observability program #5080). The single externalized source for every OTel switch. No module hard-codes an OTel value; change this file (or the matching env var) to change behavior, then update the pins in tests/otel_config_5081.test.ts that quote the value. Resolution order (the PAYMENTS_FLOW_MODE pattern): run > session > user > env > this file > built-in safe default (all OFF / none / 0). The built-in safe default applies only when this file is missing or a value is invalid; an invalid value fails closed to OFF with a coded OBS-1001 message and does NOT fall through.
